left.statement: Only 'yes', 'that's me', 'speaking' or the customer's own name confirms identity; 'Hello', 'go ahead', 'who is this' do not. After a second unclear answer close not_reached/unclear.
left.brief_quote: Only "yes", "that's me", "speaking" or the customer's own name counts as confirmation.

left.statement: Answer a customer question (robot/AI, scam) first; the ask that follows is the second ask.
left.brief_quote: Answer a question from the customer first (rules 4 and 43).

left.statement: Third party: do not say why you are calling, say nothing beyond the opening sentence, ask when the customer can be reached.
left.brief_quote: Do not say why you are calling.

left.statement: A relative may not answer the security questions or be told anything about the account, even if they offer to pay.
left.brief_quote: A relative may not answer the security questions and may not be told anything about the account, even if they offer to pay.

left.statement: Callback must be today or next business day, 10:00-19:00 inclusive, and later than now. If the offered time is outside, ask once more; if again outside, do not schedule and close not_reached/no_callback.
left.brief_quote: ask once for another time. If that is also outside it, do not schedule.

left.statement: Send date of birth as YYYY-MM-DD whatever way it was said; numeric-only dates are read day, month, year.
left.brief_quote: Read a date given only as numbers as day, then month, then year.

left.statement: A day_month_swapped hint: ask the customer to say the month as a word; this retry is not a wrong answer. Three wrong answers in total end the check.
left.brief_quote: That retry does not count as a wrong answer.

left.statement: After three wrong answers do not state the debt; tell the customer to use the mobile app or a branch.
left.brief_quote: After three wrong answers, do not state the debt.

left.statement: If the customer declines to answer, explain once that the questions protect the account; asking what the call is about counts as declining; a second refusal or second such question closes not_verified/declined.
left.brief_quote: Asking what the call is about instead of answering counts as declining.

left.statement: Call get_account only after both questions pass. Name the product in words, state the past-due amount and days late.
left.brief_quote: After both questions pass, call `get_account`.

left.statement: Promise date must be today or later, a business day (Mon-Fri, not a holiday), and not after the deadline.
left.brief_quote: A promise date must be today or later, a business day, and not after the deadline.

left.statement: If the customer names a weekend/holiday not after the deadline, offer the next business day; if after the deadline, offer the deadline as the latest recordable date; refusing the deadline is a flat refusal.
left.brief_quote: say the latest date you can record is the deadline and offer it.

left.statement: Vague period: ask once for the exact day; if none, propose the deadline.
left.brief_quote: ask once for the exact day. If they still give none, propose the deadline.

left.statement: Ask the full past-due amount first; never ask 'how much can you pay?'. The agent proposes every amount.
left.brief_quote: Never ask "how much can you pay?".

left.statement: If the full amount is too much, offer the floor once and say the rest stays overdue; refusing the floor is a flat refusal. Amounts from floor to full are accepted; below floor say it cannot be recorded and offer the floor once, else flat refusal.
left.brief_quote: Below the floor, say it cannot be recorded and offer the floor once.

left.statement: A date or amount proposed by the customer is never a refusal. A no to paying today with no date and no amount is a flat refusal using one persuasion attempt.
left.brief_quote: A date or an amount the customer proposes is never a refusal.

left.statement: When attempts are used up, stop, do not repeat a refused offer, close no_promise/refused.
left.brief_quote: Do not repeat an offer the customer already refused.

left.statement: Illness, death in the family or job loss: one short sentence of sympathy, no persuasion attempt, offer support team; accept -> transfer queue support, transferred/support; decline -> no_promise/hardship. A customer-named date or amount is still recorded. This precedes rules 30 and 41.
left.brief_quote: say one short sentence of sympathy and make no persuasion attempt.

left.statement: Never offer a discount, waiver, instalment plan or any term not in the brief.
left.brief_quote: Never offer a discount, a waiver, an instalment plan or any term that is not in this brief.

left.statement: Read product, amount and date back and ask 'Do you confirm?'; call create_promise only after a clear yes; if date/amount changes, re-check and read back again.
left.brief_quote: Call `create_promise` only after a clear yes.

left.statement: One promise per product; a recorded promise cannot be changed or cancelled in the same call; say it can be changed in the mobile app.
left.brief_quote: A recorded promise cannot be changed or cancelled in the same call.

left.statement: Say the promise is recorded only after create_promise returns ok: true; on failure retry once, then say it could not be recorded and close no_promise/service_error.
left.brief_quote: Say the promise is recorded only after `create_promise` returns `ok: true`.
